Job-market sweep for Prabhavit Gupta, Venice-based AI/automation engineer. Today is 5 August 2026. Five sweeps have run. **Do not apply to anything — discovery only.** Return as many live, well-matched roles as you can with working links. Aim for 15 or more rows.

## Candidate profile (never invent beyond this)
- ~3 years across eight European companies, mostly freelance or collaborator engagements — so contracting is his normal mode, not a fallback.
- **Indian passport, Italian EU long-term residence permit** -> no sponsorship needed anywhere in the EU **except Ireland and Denmark, which opted out of the long-term residence directive**. NOT UK, NOT Swiss, NOT US, NOT Norway authorised. **He invoices as an Italian sole trader on a Partita IVA — NOT a limited company.** He can supply a W-8BEN and will work through Deel or Remote.com if procurement insists.
- Venice-based, CET/CEST. Open to remote from Venice, remote-within-Germany, an office in any EU city, and Spain.
- Stack: n8n (deep), TypeScript/JavaScript, Next.js, React, Node, PHP/Laravel, Supabase/PostgreSQL, Playwright, Claude Code, OpenAI + Anthropic APIs, Eden AI, Make.com/Zapier/Tray.ai, RAG, LLM agents with human-in-the-loop, Docker, AWS basics.
- Flagship: FlowSpace (Mar 2024 to ongoing) — 2,000 to 4,500+ users, led Bubble.io to Next.js + Laravel migration on a live product, built AI support agents, CRM lead capture and enrichment, GTM/outbound automations, scraping/parsing pipeline. Also Urlink (built a platform largely with AI, acting as PM and developer), UltraStrategy (CV-parsing tool in n8n + Eden AI), Clubee (API integration, unit testing, QA).
- **No GitHub. No CS degree.** No Java, no Go/Rust, no Python backend depth, no Kubernetes, no Vue, no C#/.NET, no ML research. English only.
- Salary target EUR 30,000-40,000. Contract EUR 200/day (~EUR 25/hr), though he already quoted USD 45/hr to one AI-evaluation firm and that number stands with them.

## Your slice: two clusters nobody has swept

**(a) Genuinely global-remote roles.** Companies that hire "anywhere in the world" or "any timezone" — these sidestep every eligibility problem he has. Query terms: "remote worldwide", "work from anywhere", "any timezone", "globally distributed", "remote - global", "async-first". Also worth a pass: **web3 and crypto-adjacent companies**, which are unusually global-remote and often contract-friendly (he has already applied to one blockchain-data company, so the domain is not new to him). Look at: Chainlink Labs, Consensys, Aave, Safe, Gnosis, Lido, The Graph, Alchemy, QuickNode, Thirdweb, Dune, Nansen, Blockdaemon, Fireblocks, Ledger is excluded, Bitpanda, Kraken, Bitstamp, MoonPay, Ramp Network, Transak, Request Finance, Morpho, Spark, Sky, Zerion, Rainbow, Phantom, Reown/WalletConnect, Push, Covalent, Goldsky is excluded.

**(b) AI evaluation, data and agent-training contract work, paid hourly.** This is a real, large market that suits his rate and his freelance setup, and he has already been engaged in it once (G2i, AI Interaction Evaluator, USD 45/hr). Companies: Surge AI, Scale AI / Outlier, Mercor, Handshake AI, Turing, Invisible is excluded, Micro1, Snorkel is excluded, Labelbox, Appen, TELUS International AI, Sigma AI, Innodata, Prolific, Pareto.AI, DataAnnotation, Alignerr, Toloka is excluded, Remotasks, Sama, CloudFactory, iMerit, Centaur AI, Braintrust is excluded. Prioritise roles that want **software-engineering judgement** (code review of AI output, agent trajectory evaluation, prompt engineering, tool-use evaluation) over generic annotation, and **state the hourly rate wherever it is published** — that is the most decision-relevant fact for him in this cluster.

**Hosts** (WebSearch `allowed_domains` is a hard filter): `jobs.ashbyhq.com`, `job-boards.greenhouse.io`, `job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io`, `jobs.lever.co`, `jobs.eu.lever.co`, `jobs.workable.com`, `join.com`, `jobs.smartrecruiters.com`, `weworkremotely.com`, `remoteok.com`, `himalayas.app`, `remotive.com`, `jobicy.com`, `wellfound.com`, `cryptojobslist.com`, `web3.career`. Also try org boards directly: `api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/<org>` and `boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/<org>/jobs?content=true` to FIND things, then verify separately.

**Bias toward postings dated within the last 21 days**, but report strong older matches if verified.

## Verification — read twice
**Ashby posting pages are client-rendered and a DELETED Ashby URL still serves its old page title** — four top finds in an earlier sweep were reported live by `api.ashbyhq.com` and returned "Job not found" in a real browser. **Greenhouse board APIs report closed jobs as live** and the posting URL then serves the multi-job board index; `?gh_jid=` variants serve the index while clean `/jobs/<id>` URLs serve the posting. For every row: fetch the posting URL, require BODY content, and **state your confidence with what you actually saw.**

Two specific traps for your slice: crypto job boards are full of scraped, months-dead listings — always land on the employer's own ATS before reporting. And AI-evaluation firms run evergreen talent-pool reqs that never close; say so where that is what you are looking at, and note whether the posting names a real rate.

Arize, Arkipel, Ascending AI, Absorb, Attio, Avatria, Avery, BearingPoint, Ben, Bullpen, Camunda, Catawiki, Celonis, Checkly, Clera, Codex, Cognite, Cohere, Contentful, Cosuno, Creatunity, Cresta, DADA ENERGY, Dash0, Dataiku, Docplanner, Dust, Duvo, EggAI, Eight Sleep, ElevenLabs, Eneba, epilot, Facile.it, Filigran, Fueled, G2i, Glacis, Goldsky, Goodweek, GRAI, Gensyn, Helloprint, HiPeople, Integral, Invisible Technologies, Jamie, Jimdo, JobLeads, Kairos, KFS, Kota, Langdock, Laioutr, leadtech, LeadX Pro, Lia, Lleverage, Loomya, Lovable, MailerLite, MAIA, Make, Mavriq, Mercura, Mindrift, Toloka, MMDSmart, Moneyfarm, Monterail, Musixmatch, MyEdSpace, NineTwoThree, Novosafe, Nuitee, Oh, OpenHands, Orb, Otonomee, Parloa, peopleIX, Pinnipedia, Pragmatike, Quadrivia, Reaktor, Reedsy, Reflow, Remote People, Resend, Reverse, RevOS, Riverflex, Runpod, salesHAX, SalesCaptain, Satispay, Shippeo, SIXT, Snorkel, Sourcegraph, Starbridge, Stackgini, Sunday Natural, Super Technologies, Superchat, supermodular, Supabase, Sysdig, Tandem Health, Taxfix, TEVEO, tem, The Flex, The Global Talent Co, Tiugo, Treatwell, Twilio, Unframe, Vercel, Viktor, Visma, Wayflyer, Wypoon, YLD, ZOE, Zapier, alago, cargovibe, dexter health, n8n, neptune.ai, Ledger, Braintrust, micro1 (already noted as a marketplace — only report it if you find a specific engineering-judgement req with a published rate).

## Scoring (total 100)
role match 30 + eligibility and work basis 25 + stack overlap 20 + seniority realism 15 + signal quality 10. A genuinely global-remote contract role that accepts an Italian sole-trader invoice should score near the top of the eligibility 25. Kill most of it for US-only, UK-only, Irish, Danish, Swiss or Norwegian authorisation. Penalise faceless talent marketplaces on signal quality, but do NOT exclude them — hourly AI-evaluation work is a legitimate income stream for him and he has done it before.

## Output — return this and nothing else. One block per role scoring 55+:

### <score> - <role title> · <company>
- **Where:** <verbatim location/eligibility sentence> · Tier 1 (Venice today) / 2 (EU but a move) / 3 (outside reach) · Employee or Contract
- **Pay:** <figures, and for the AI-evaluation cluster the hourly rate if published, or "not disclosed"> · **Posted:** <date, or "not stated">
- **Basis:** <can he invoice as an Italian sole trader, or do they require an entity / employment? state what the posting actually says, or "not stated">
- **Why:** two or three sentences tied to specific things he has actually done.
- **Watch-outs:** the honest gaps, named.
- **Apply:** <canonical application URL>
- **Verified:** <what you fetched, what you saw, your confidence, and whether it looks like an evergreen talent-pool req>

Then a "dead or unverifiable" list and the queries you ran. No preamble.
